# CÔNG TY TNHH CÔNG NGHỆ CREDITBIRD (CreditBird Technology)

> CreditBird is an enterprise technology engineering company founded in 2018 in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Specializing in high-performance custom software engineering (Rust, Go, SvelteKit), the Kelvot ERP platform, the RustSale CRM desktop application, dedicated senior IT staffing, and industrial IoT cold-air scent marketing systems (Lemy Finest).

## Core Products & Solutions

### 1. RustSale CRM & Outreach (Desktop Application)
- **URL:** https://creditbirdtech.com/products/rustsale
- **Architecture:** Local-first desktop application developed in Rust with SQLite embedded storage.
- **Performance:** 50,000+ messages per second, sub-millisecond local indexing.
- **Key Capabilities:**
  - Omnichannel Unified Inbox aggregating Zalo Personal/OA, Facebook Messenger, and WhatsApp Business.
  - Cold Email Engine with domain rotation, bounce handling, and automated follow-up sequences.
  - Visual Kanban Sales Pipeline with automated stage transitions.
  - Offline-first operation: full local search and message history without internet dependency.
- **Linux Quick Installer:** `curl -fsSL https://rustsale.creditbirdtech.com/install-linux.sh | bash`
- **Documentation & User Guide:** https://app.notion.com/p/RustSale-CRM-Outreach-Pro-C-m-Nang-S-D-ng-To-n-T-p-3d2344ba47fa8114a415e5618ad83e39

### 2. Kelvot ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning)
- **URL:** https://creditbirdtech.com/solutions/erp
- **Portal:** https://kelvot.com
- **Target Audience:** Mid-market and enterprise manufacturers, wholesale distributors, and multi-branch retail chains.
- **Core Modules:**
  - **Manufacturing & BOM:** Multi-level Bill of Materials, production planning, MRP calculation, real-time scrap tracking.
  - **WMS Warehouse Management:** Multi-warehouse, batch/lot tracking, barcode/QR workflows, automated FIFO replenishment.
  - **Financial & Cost Accounting:** Full Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) compliance, automated general ledger, journal entries, and real-time cash flow telemetry.
  - **Supply Chain (SCM):** Supplier scorecards, purchase order approval matrix, and freight tracking.

### 3. Scent Marketing & IoT Diffusers (Lemy Finest)
- **URL:** https://creditbirdtech.com/solutions/scent-marketing
- **Brand Website:** https://www.lemyfinest.com
- **Technology:** Two-fluid Cold-Air Nano Nebulization technology with sub-micron droplet suspension (< 1 micron).
- **Products:**
  - Desktop IoT Diffusers for luxury boutiques, hotel suites, and executive offices.
  - HVAC Central Ducted Systems covering up to 5,000 m³ with building automation integration.
  - 100% Pure Natural Essential Oils verified by GC-MS (Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry) and Certificate of Analysis (COA).

### 4. Custom Software Engineering & Architecture
- **URL:** https://creditbirdtech.com/solutions/software
- **Tech Stack:** Rust, Go, Python, SvelteKit, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Docker, Kubernetes.
- **Engagement Model:** Full lifecycle development from requirement discovery to production deployment. 100% source code transfer with zero vendor lock-in.

### 5. Dedicated IT Staffing & Squad Augmentation
- **URL:** https://creditbirdtech.com/solutions/it-staffing
- **Talent Pool:** Senior Fullstack, Backend (Rust/Go), Mobile, and DevOps engineers.
- **Process:** Candidate matching within 48 hours, 14-day risk-free evaluation trial, strict B2B NDA compliance.
